substantiveCommits.message: qa: enforce gate integrity inside core evaluator
qa: record core evaluator enforcement rule
qa: seal rooftop period crops in native capture
qa: declare sealed rooftop period crops
qa: require rooftop period evidence for authenticity score
qa: bind rooftop observability to sealed capture

findings.summary: The exact owner-approved Visual Fidelity Gate and reviewed-evidence exact-set checks were strongly enforced by MenuItem validators, but the public core evaluator could be invoked directly by -executeMethod, reflection, or another runner entry point without traversing those menu validators.
priorCoreBehavior: QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.ValidateConfig enforced threshold 92, native 3840x2160, nine category IDs, weights summing to 100, and only a coarse critical-defect-count floor.
Exact per-category weights/hard minima and the exact canonical twelve critical-defect IDs lived in QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA.

Duplicate/unknown reviewed categories, duplicate/unknown critical-defect reviews, mandatory correctiveAction text, and exact reviewed-entry counts lived in QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA.
Render provenance was already intrinsic to the core evaluator, so this finding concerns scoring-schema integrity rather than still-image byte provenance.
findings.risk: A non-menu caller could theoretically evaluate a rebalanced or otherwise weakened but still 100-point-total configuration, or bypass reviewed-document exact-set hardening, creating a false PASS path even though normal editor UI remained guarded.

findings.summary: The period-authentic rooftop receiving assembly already had dedicated hero/oblique 1280x720 exact-texel crops and projection QA, but those two crop IDs were outside the canonical QualityBlock4KCapture cropRecords and outside the scoring observability allow-list.
findings.risk: The dedicated roof crops could be useful for human review but were not first-class scoreable evidence sealed through the same runtime 4K manifest/receipt path. Period authenticity scoring therefore relied on broader facade/service crops even though more discriminating rooftop evidence existed.

changes: QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.ValidateGateConfig now invokes QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA.ValidateContract from inside the core method.

QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.EvaluateVisualGate now invokes QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA.ValidateContract and QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA.ValidateReviewedEvidence before category scoring.
visual_gate_integrity_contract.json records the core-entrypoint enforcement rule so later refactors cannot silently move protection back to menu-only validation.
QualityBlock4KCapture now emits hero/rooftop_period_hardware and oblique/rooftop_reception_oblique as canonical native 1280x720 100% cropRecords from the 3840x2160 frames.
The capture contract rejects blank/duplicate crop IDs and locks both rooftop crop rectangles to x=1280, y=1440, width=1280, height=720.
The static 4k_capture_manifest template now declares both roof crops while remaining renderProducedByUnity=false and UNSCORED until Unity runtime replaces it.

visual_evidence_observability_contract schema 1.2 adds both canonical roof crop references and requires Period Authenticity to cite facade_right, balcony_services, frontal rooftop hardware, and oblique rooftop reception evidence before scoring.

benchmark_observability_contract schema 1.1 now identifies QualityBlock4KCapture as canonical crop owner and QualityBlockRenderEvidenceProvenanceQA as the sealing authority; the separate rooftop observability manifest remains an observability receipt rather than an alternate provenance source.

sourceChecks: Fetched the modified core evaluator after commit and confirmed intrinsic gate-integrity and reviewed-evidence calls are present before category scoring.
Confirmed the new core validation calls do not recurse into QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.

Confirmed existing render provenance accepts a positive number of cropRecords per view rather than hard-coding the previous three-crop count, so adding the two canonical roof crops does not intentionally weaken provenance semantics.
The canonical roof crop rectangles match the existing BenchmarkObservability view requirements exactly and stay inside 3840x2160 at native scale.
No runtime receipt, compile artifact, or actual capture was fabricated.
verification.selfAudit: After the first gate-entrypoint fix, the run inspected the existing period observability pipeline and found that its high-value rooftop crops were separate from canonical scoreable cropRecords. The run therefore promoted those crops into the sealed native capture path and made them mandatory for period-authenticity review instead of leaving the run at a purely schema-level hardening change.

expectedVisualScoreImpactWhenRenderedAnd.gateValidity: Any future >=92 result must survive immutable exact category weights/minima, exact twelve critical defects, reviewed-entry integrity, and existing render provenance even when invoked outside the editor menu.
expectedVisualScoreImpactWhenRenderedAnd.periodAuthenticity: The 7-point Period Authenticity category now requires two dedicated rooftop crops in addition to occupied facade/service evidence, making analogue-era rooftop hardware and its installation directly inspectable from frontal and oblique native pixels.
expectedVisualScoreImpactWhenRenderedAnd.geometryConstruction: The same sealed roof crops expose ballast-to-roof contact, mast/base load path, boom/element structure, feed boxes and coax routing for construction deductions if they fail in actual pixels.
expectedVisualScoreImpactWhenRenderedAnd.materialPbr: The oblique sealed roof crop provides a dedicated angular view for galvanized steel versus dielectric ABS/PVC/concrete response, but no Material/PBR points are awarded without actual render review.

nextBlocker: Actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and runtime execution. At first availability, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. Confirm the two new rooftop cropRecords are produced, survive exact-pixel provenance validation, and are bound into the same sealed receipt as their source full frames. Then inspect real hero/oblique/grazing frames and temporal evidence before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
nextSourceSideTargetIfRuntimeStillUnavai: Strengthen camera/crop synchronization by making BenchmarkObservability consume or cross-check the authoritative QualityBlock4KCapture view definitions rather than maintaining duplicated camera pose/FOV constants, while keeping physical antenna dimensions unchanged.
recordingNote: The earlier create/update commits for this run-record file are bookkeeping and intentionally excluded from substantiveCommits.
note: This run improves score validity and the observability/provenance of a real period-authentic asset, but does not claim any visual quality from source alone. Implementation Readiness remains separate from Visual Fidelity.
